question: Rigveda is the earliest specimen of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indo European language**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Rigveda is one of the oldest known texts composed in an early form of Sanskrit, an Indo-European language.
 
• It dates back to around 1500-1200 BCE, making it one of the earliest specimens of the Indo-European language family.
 
• The text was orally transmitted for many centuries before being written down, reflecting the linguistic and cultural practices of the Vedic civilization.
